entities.name: Item / part
entities.description: A raw material, component, sub-assembly, or finished product in the master catalog.

relationships.note: optional, if the item is manufactured

provenance.notes: InvenTree's Part model and Odoo's product.template/product.product (referenced throughout mrp models) both implement this.

entities.name: Bill of materials
entities.description: The header record defining what components (and optionally operations) are needed to build one unit of a parent item.

provenance.notes: InvenTree's BomItem (parent Part + bom_checksum/bom_validated) and Odoo's mrp.bom (product_qty, uom_id, type: normal/phantom, operation_ids, byproduct_ids) both implement this.

entities.name: BOM line / component
entities.description: A single required component and quantity within a bill of materials.

provenance.notes: InvenTree's BomItem rows and Odoo's mrp.bom.line model both implement this.

entities.name: BOM by-product
entities.description: A secondary item produced alongside the primary output, defined on the BOM.

provenance.notes: Odoo's mrp.bom.byproduct model; not found in the cloned InvenTree scope. Single source.

entities.name: Routing operation
entities.description: A single step in the sequence of operations required to manufacture an item, performed at a work center.

provenance.notes: Odoo's mrp.routing.workcenter model; not found in the cloned InvenTree scope. Single source.

entities.name: Work center
entities.description: A production resource (machine, line, or team) where operations are performed.

provenance.notes: Verbatim from Odoo's mrp.workcenter.working_state selection field; single source, not modeled distinctly in the cloned InvenTree scope.

entities.name: Production / work order
entities.description: An order to manufacture a quantity of an item, tracked from draft through completion.

provenance.notes: InvenTree's Build model (BuildStatus: pending/production/on_hold/cancelled/complete) and Odoo's mrp.production (state: draft/confirmed/progress/to_close/done/cancel) are independent implementations with different exact vocabularies; the merged states list here reconciles both, see workflows.json for the two verbatim vocabularies.

entities.name: Work order (operation)
entities.description: The execution of a single routing operation for a production order at a specific work center.

provenance.notes: Verbatim from Odoo's mrp.workorder.state selection field; single source, InvenTree does not model operation-level execution separately from the Build itself in the cloned scope.

entities.name: Stock item (lot / serial)
entities.description: A quantity of an item at a location, optionally identified by a batch/lot number or a unique serial number.

relationships.note: optional, if produced by or consumed in a build

standard_mapping.note: Name-only reference; std:gs1-epcis not yet acquired locally at time of writing.

provenance.notes: States list is verbatim from InvenTree's StockStatus enum; Odoo's stock.lot models the lot/serial identity independently, corroborating the general concept.

entities.name: Stock location
entities.description: A node in a hierarchical structure of physical storage locations.

provenance.notes: InvenTree's StockLocation (InvenTreeTree) and StockLocationType models; single source.

entities.name: Supplier
entities.description: An external company that supplies raw materials or components, or performs a subcontracted operation.

provenance.notes: InvenTree's company app (Company/SupplierPart/ManufacturerPart models); single source.

entities.name: Purchase order
entities.description: An order placed with a supplier for raw materials or components.

provenance.notes: Verbatim from InvenTree's PurchaseOrderStatus enum; single source.

entities.name: Quality inspection
entities.description: A pass/fail test result recorded against a test template for a part or a specific stock item.

provenance.notes: InvenTree's PartTestTemplate and StockItemTestResult models; single source.

entities.name: Non-conformance
entities.description: A logged defect or failed inspection requiring disposition (rework, scrap, use-as-is, return to supplier).

relationships.note: optional, if raised from a failed test

provenance.notes: Reasoned extension of InvenTree's StockStatus (ATTENTION/DAMAGED/REJECTED/QUARANTINED) and StockItemTestResult failures; no dedicated non-conformance table found, states list is reasoned.

entities.name: Traceability record
entities.description: An append-only genealogy event linking a stock item to the components consumed or the parent build that produced it.

standard_mapping.note: Not yet verified against a local copy of the spec at time of writing; noted as a likely future alignment, not asserted as implemented.

provenance.notes: InvenTree's StockItemTracking model (with StockHistoryCode entries like INSTALLED_CHILD_ITEM/REMOVED_CHILD_ITEM/BUILD_OUTPUT_COMPLETED) and Odoo's stock.lot + mrp.production.lot_producing_ids both provide the data needed for genealogy tracing.

entities.name: Product variant
entities.description: A specific buildable/sellable variant of a template item, e.g. by size or color.

provenance.notes: InvenTree's Part.variant_of/is_template fields and Odoo's product.template vs. product.product split both model this.
